name: xclusive
description: Assets of the Xclusive Ballonvaarten template, a child of Cassiopeia.

assets.name: template.xclusive.fonts.roboto
assets.description: Roboto family (theme text), same Google Fonts URLs as the Joomla 3 template.

assets.name: template.xclusive.fonts.lato
assets.description: Lato (paragraphs, lists, h2-h4, menus), as set in the Joomla 3 template style.

assets.name: template.xclusive.fonts.playfair
assets.description: Playfair Display (h1), the URL of the Joomla 3 template style. This old css API URL only delivers weight 400; the browser makes the 800 of h1 by synthetic bold, as on the old site.

assets.name: template.xclusive.fonts
assets.description: All web fonts of the template.

assets.name: template.xclusive.bs3
assets.description: Bootstrap 3 rules the old theme depends on, restated on top of Cassiopeia.

assets.name: template.xclusive.legacy
assets.description: Theme rules ported from xclusive-joostrap (style.css, j-backbone.css).

assets.name: template.xclusive.compat
assets.description: Fixes for Joomla 6 / Cassiopeia after the legacy theme rules.
